	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = wool_resource_building_5
			aub_can_upgrade_to_wool_resource_building_6_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = resource_district_normal_tier_6_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = wool_resource_building_5
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = wool_resource_building_6 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = resource_district_normal_tier_6_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = wool_resource_building_6
			aub_can_upgrade_to_wool_resource_building_7_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = resource_district_normal_tier_7_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = wool_resource_building_6
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = wool_resource_building_7 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = resource_district_normal_tier_7_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = wool_resource_building_7
			aub_can_upgrade_to_wool_resource_building_8_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = resource_district_normal_tier_8_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = wool_resource_building_7
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = wool_resource_building_8 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = resource_district_normal_tier_8_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = wool_resource_building_8
			aub_can_upgrade_to_wool_resource_building_9_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = resource_district_normal_tier_9_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = wool_resource_building_8
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = wool_resource_building_9 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = resource_district_normal_tier_9_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = wool_resource_building_9
			aub_can_upgrade_to_wool_resource_building_10_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = resource_district_normal_tier_10_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = wool_resource_building_9
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = wool_resource_building_10 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = resource_district_normal_tier_10_cost }
		}
	}
}
